review_summary: Students consistently praise instructors Ronny and Erwin as patient, professional and good-humoured, with many reporting they passed in one attempt - especially for the motorcycle (A/AVB/AVD) and trailer (BE) categories, which dominate the reviews. The picture is overwhelmingly positive (5.0/5 over ~128 Google reviews) but rests entirely on Google and Facebook with no independent verified-platform reviews and no negative or English-language feedback, so the unbroken positivity should be read with mild caution.
